From now on, every report submitted with the Shift+F tool will include the last AutoSave, making it easier to reproduce game states and detect errors. 🙌

💙 Thank you all for your constant support and help in improving Pro Football every day. Together, we’ll keep making this project even better! ⚽

Enjoy the new version!
The Pro Football Team 🚀

notes.title: Early Access v0.0.35-dev Update Released!
notes.content:

After the launch of the Early Access, it’s been an incredibly intense but truly rewarding day! 🥳 I’d like to thank you all for the support, involvement, and kindness you’ve shown. ❤️

notes.title: 🚀 Pro Football Early Access Launch! ⚽️
notes.content:
Hello, Managers!

We’re thrilled to announce that Pro Football is officially available in Early Access on Steam! This marks the beginning of an exciting journey, and we’re inviting you to join us in shaping the future of the game.

💡 Why Early Access?
Launching in Early Access allows us to work closely with the community to create the best football manager experience possible. Your feedback will be instrumental in refining gameplay, adding features, and fixing issues as we move forward. Together, we can make Pro Football something truly special.

🔧 What to Expect:
Regular updates with new features, content, and improvements.
A development plan focused on community feedback and evolving the game based on your suggestions.
Transparent communication and a commitment to delivering the best possible experience.
📢 How Can You Help?
Your feedback is vital! Report bugs, share your ideas, and let us know what you’d like to see improved. Join the discussion in our forums or on Discord, where your voice will help shape the future of Pro Football.

❤️ Thank You!
We’re incredibly grateful to everyone who has supported us so far. Whether it’s by purchasing the game, reporting bugs, or simply spreading the word, you’re a key part of this project.

Let’s build Pro Football together!

Stay tuned for updates, and thank you for being part of this journey!

— The Pro Football Team
